items.text: The FCC released drafts of new broadband coverage maps that show where broadband currently exists in the U.S. and where it does not. Many places in VA still do not have access to these services. These maps will be used to allocate future funding.

I am proud to cosponsor the DITCH Act to ensure we are prioritizing U.S. interests over profiting off the Chinese market.

American universities should not receive preferential treatment if they choose to finance a genocidal communist regime.
https://t.co/HnZjG8poIn

I am praying for strength and a speedy recovery for my friend @SteveScalise as he begins treatment – I have no doubt he will tackle this with the same energy and tenacity he brings to the House floor.

As co-chair of the Public Health Caucus, I am committed to protecting the health of all Virginians.

Great to tour @Walmart’s new HIV screening facility in Ashland where Virginians can get the care they need with rapid testing and treatment from pharmacists. https://t.co/EwlhiF8Vdf

As co-chair of the Congressional Public Health Caucus, I'm very proud that Virginia is home to some of the best hospitals in the U.S.

Great to meet with the Virginia Hospital and Healthcare Association to discuss ways to improve the quality of healthcare available to Virginians. https://t.co/1DFcd0CtMN

I had the pleasure of meeting with @VaRuralHealth to discuss access, workforce, and quality of healthcare issues for rural Virginians.

It's important we address the unique challenges facing rural healthcare patients to ensure they receive the care they deserve. https://t.co/ewoa3pLnH3

Virginia is the proud home to a significant veteran population, and we must ensure they receive the care and treatment they deserve.

I recently met with the @wwp, including one of my own constituents, to discuss how Congress can best support our veterans. https://t.co/oWaa9CFttI

I'm proud to introduce the Organ Donation Referral Improvement Act to remove barriers to adopting automated electronic organ donor referrals in health systems nationwide so we can give hope to patients waiting for the gift of life.

More ⬇️
https://t.co/Vtg6MUbrIv

DON’T FORGET: Daylight saving time ends today!

Before you head to bed, remember to turn your clocks back one hour and enjoy the extra sleep. https://t.co/ozuhARs5g8

I am saddened to hear of my Virginia delegation colleague’s cancer diagnosis. 

Kathryn and I are praying for a swift, successful treatment and recovery.

I have no doubt Gerry will fight this terrible disease with the same spirit he fights with on behalf of Virginia’s 11th District.

As the co-chair of the Congressional Public Health Caucus, I'm working to reduce barriers to care in rural communities by expanding telemedicine and investing in lifesaving cures. 

On #NationalRuralHealthDay, we recognize the efforts of healthcare providers who care for the 61 million Americans living in rural areas.

Folks, please exercise caution if you plan to travel this weekend as Virginia prepares for the incoming winter storm.  

Stay tuned to your local news and @VDEM for updates.

Due to impending hazardous weather conditions, our mobile office hours in Colonial Beach scheduled for Monday 1/6 are canceled.

My staff will be available at (804) 401-4120 to assist constituents.

Please exercise caution if you must travel tomorrow, and stay tuned to @VDEM and @VaDOT for updates.

By harnessing the power of technology, we can streamline the organ donation referral process, giving healthcare providers more time to save lives.

Today I introduced my bipartisan Organ Donation Referral Improvement Act to do just that.

https://t.co/VNwCBkBJMx

After the crisis subsides, I will request a briefing from Richmond City officials to understand how this happened and how the infrastructure supporting other water treatment plants in the area might impact our constituents in the future.

This simply cannot happen again.

As co-chair of the Public Health Caucus in Congress, I was proud to meet with @_CHKD, one of the premier pediatric medical centers in Virginia. 

Children's Hospital of The King's Daughters serves countless Virginians and patients across the East Coast, and is a cornerstone of the health systems that serves the many military dependents in the greater Hampton Roads region.

The Advanced Career Education (ACE) Center at Hermitage High School offers hands-on, skills-based training for @HenricoSchools juniors and seniors, leading to licensure or certification in fields like construction, healthcare, transportation, and public safety.

I enjoyed touring their state-of-the-art facility and speaking with bright students about my bipartisan Freedom to Invest in Tomorrow’s Workforce Act. It’s wonderful to see the next generation preparing for in-demand careers!

Folks, please exercise caution and follow guidance from @VDEM, @VaDOT, and your local news as the Richmond region is under a tornado warning. 

Remember to stay #WeatherAware — your safety comes first.

As a @VCU alum myself and co-chair of the Congressional Public Health Caucus, I always appreciate the chance to speak with Dr. Marlon Levy of @VCUHealth. 

We discussed federal legislation to protect healthcare workers and how to reduce barriers to healthcare. https://t.co/Yce6S0PTlm

Before coming to Congress, I earned a master’s degree in public health. My educational background taught me how much of an impact federal healthcare policy has on surgery centers.

I learned so much during my tour of the Virginia Cardiovascular Specialists' Heart & Vascular Center in Henrico and enjoyed discussing pertinent federal legislation with their impressive team!

World-class research institutions like @VCU & @Virginia_Tech drive healthcare innovation and support our medical workforce.

I’m advocating for federal research funding in the Commonwealth so we can remain at the forefront of medical advancements.
https://t.co/eW0yyArW4A

I am advocating for Virginia’s research institutions to receive the critical funding they need.

These world-class universities are key to driving innovation, advancing medical research, and boosting our Commonwealth’s economy.

That’s why I’m urging House leadership to protect coverage and strengthen this essential program in upcoming budget negotiations.
